## About Us

Bloomlala produces floral inspired fashion apparel and accessories featuring gorgeous floral

From the origin of its name to its distinctive characteristics and rich mythology, each flower is
infused with symbolism and meaning that's timeless and universal. Our collections evoke the beauty
and eternal elegance of the flower.

# Welcome to FloraLife

For 85 years and counting, FloraLife has been the flower care experts and worldwide leader in
postharvest flower care and handling. Since the invention of the first flower food in 1938, we’ve
continued to partner with our clients to address specific quality concerns and create a line of
floral care products formulated specifically to feed, hydrate, nourish and protect at every level of
the distribution chain. As a globally positioned company, we are proud to offer our expertise,
consultation and education to anyone in the floral industry seeking the knowledge and tools
necessary to provide the freshest and longest lasting flowers to their customers.

FloraLife is a division of Smithers-Oasis Company, a globally positioned company dedicated to the
innovation and needs of the floral industry worldwide. As a true one-stop shop, we aim to provide
the products, services and continued education that enables our customers to maximize the longevity
of their floral products and designs.

**We help our customers exceed their consumers’ expectations, providing positive experiences that
elevate the industry and generate repeat purchases.**

formulated to maximize the vase life of your fresh cut flowers. Our continued goal in every product
that we engineer and produce is to help our customers shrink the shrink and ensure the best cut
flower experience for consumers.

At every point of the distribution chain, we are there to offer innovation, consultation and a wide
range of products that keep flowers properly hydrated, nourished and treated through the
postharvest, storage, transportation, display and consumer phases.

proper flower care and handling protocols in place not only ensures that you put top quality flowers
in the hands of consumers, but it also can significantly reduce waste which in turn reduces your
footprint on the planet.

## When science meets innovation beautiful things grow

# Welcome to FloraLife

For 85 years and counting, FloraLife has been the flower care experts and worldwide leader in
postharvest flower care and handling. Since the invention of the first flower food in 1938, we’ve
continued to partner with our clients to address specific quality concerns and create a line of
floral care products formulated specifically to feed, hydrate, nourish and protect at every level of
the distribution chain. As a globally positioned company, we are proud to offer our expertise,
consultation and education to anyone in the floral industry seeking the knowledge and tools
necessary to provide the freshest and longest lasting flowers to their customers.

FloraLife is a division of Smithers-Oasis Company, a globally positioned company dedicated to the
innovation and needs of the floral industry worldwide. As a true one-stop shop, we aim to provide
the products, services and continued education that enables our customers to maximize the longevity
of their floral products and designs.

**We help our customers exceed their consumers’ expectations, providing positive experiences that
elevate the industry and generate repeat purchases.**

[Floralife is for Optimal flower care]
Find Out More Expand

Farm to vase, as your total care solution provider for cut flowers, FloraLife products are specially
formulated to maximize the vase life of your fresh cut flowers. Our continued goal in every product
that we engineer and produce is to help our customers shrink the shrink and ensure the best cut
flower experience for consumers.

At every point of the distribution chain, we are there to offer innovation, consultation and a wide
range of products that keep flowers properly hydrated, nourished and treated through the
postharvest, storage, transportation, display and consumer phases.

[Floralife Optimal Flower Care]
[Innovating]
[Floralife is for Innovating]
Find Out More Expand

At Smithers-Oasis, our proud tradition of innovation for the floral industry was established in 1938
with the invention of the first FloraLife® Flower Food, followed by the invention of OASIS® branded
floral foam in 1954. Over the years we’ve had many groundbreaking innovations that have changed our
beloved industry forever. From our inception, we’ve remained resolute in our pursuit of excellence.

We pride ourselves in having one of the largest research and development staff solely dedicated to
the science and technology of fresh cut flowers. Our highly trained chemists and on-staff
horticulturists continuously test and evaluate our products as well as develop new products based on
the emerging needs of the industry. Our team's dedication and commitment are to ensure that our
customers receive the best products available, anywhere.

We strive to address the specific needs of the cut flower industry, offering innovative products and
solutions to satisfy those needs. Our goal is to help our customers provide the freshest, most
attractive, and longest-lasting flowers possible. It is our passion to maximize the consumer's
experience with flowers!

[Floralife is for Sustainable living]
Find Out More Expand

It has never been as important as it is today to track and reduce our footprint on the planet.
Growing, processing and distributing flowers use many resources to guarantee that high quality,
beautiful fresh cut flowers reach the hands of consumers. At FloraLife, we have focused our
sustainability plan on 5 key commitments to reduce our impact on the planet and help all our
partners, big and small, reduce theirs too. The 5 commitments are climate change, water stewardship,
product portfolio, sustainable packaging and stakeholder awareness.

Floral industry waste impacts almost all areas of sustainability. Putting measures in place to
reduce it should be top of mind. Every stem requires land to grow, water to hydrate, products to
treat, energy to cool, packaging to protect, fuel to ship and lots of labor. When a flower does not
make it to the end consumer, it is not only the flower that is wasted. It is also all the resources
that went into growing, packaging, protecting and shipping it through the long chain. Having the
proper flower care and handling protocols in place not only ensures that you put top quality flowers
in the hands of consumers, but it also can significantly reduce waste which in turn reduces your
footprint on the planet.

Together, we can make a bigger difference!

At FloraLife, we share our expert cut flower knowledge, products, and services to help educate every
level of our industry. As the flower care experts, we are passionate about the pursuit of education
and what it can mean for the success of the entire industry. Our team is globally positioned and
accessible for your educational needs. Our experts can be on-site to conduct care and handling,
proper practices and protocols, as well as merchandising training. We present monthly webinars,
publish research papers and educational articles, and speak at industry events.

We are always searching for new and better ways to reach all levels of the flower community to
further educate and promote the business of fresh cut flowers. One of the education innovation we
pride ourselves in is the Flower Food for Thought® program… because an educated consumer is a repeat
purchaser, and a growing educated consumer base means a growing floral industry!

# Why Choose Proven Winners?

Proven Winners searches the world to bring you vibrant flowering annuals, perennials and shrubs that
deliver the most beautiful garden performance. When you grow Proven Winners, you'll surely fall in
love. Our plants have been proven in trials conducted in numerous sites worldwide to be:
* Easy to grow and care for
* Covered with blooms
* Bright and colorful
* Healthy and vigorous
* Long-blooming
* Trialed and tested

## Experience the Ambius difference

We create spaces where both people and brands flourish. From effortless plantscapes to scenting and
holiday décor, Ambius designers and technical experts infuse nature into every detail for an
unforgettable experience.

##### Seamless service and expertise

Experience dependable customer support, digital service reporting, and unmatched local technical
expertise.

##### Pest-free plants, guaranteed

It couldn’t be easier to feel confident in your space. If pests appear, we swiftly handle it.

##### Trusted, safety-first partner

Our fully vetted teams become an extension of yours—professional, polite, and safety-focused.

##### Industry-leading plants, cultivated to last

Enjoy plants that thrive from day one thanks to strong roots and premium sourcing in our specialized
centers.

##### Unforgettable sensory experiences

Outshine the ordinary with turn-key living walls, moss wall art, seasonal displays, and scenting.

##### Supporting your sustainability

Amplify your sustainability initiatives with knowledgeable experts who can support your
certification efforts.

# We Aspire To Be Our Customers’
# Most Valuable Supplier

### Your Trusted Wholesale Floral Partner

For more than 65 years, DVFlora has supplied professional retail florists and event designers with
premium fresh-cut flowers, botanicals and floral hardgoods sourced from leading growers and
suppliers around the world. Our strategically located distribution network, including our
headquarters in Sewell, New Jersey, our Southeast hub in Augusta, Georgia, [Marvin’s Wholesale
Florist][37] serving the Indianapolis market, and [Rokay Flowers][38] serving Michigan, provides
dependable next-day service, exceptional product availability, and the flexibility to order by the
bunch, piece, or case. Backed by knowledgeable floral professionals and a commitment to your
success, we’re here to help your business succeed.

## Our Floral & Hardgood Products


### Flowers

From everyday staples to premium specialty blooms, DVFlora offers one of the industry’s largest
selections of fresh-cut flowers sourced from leading growers around the world. Our commitment to
cold-chain management and expert product handling helps ensure every stem arrives with the
freshness, quality, and vase life your customers expect.


### Greens

Complete every arrangement with an extensive selection of fresh-cut greens, foliage, and seasonal
evergreens. Sourced from trusted growers across the globe, our inventory includes everyday
essentials, specialty varieties, and over 100 holiday evergreen selections to help you create
beautiful designs throughout the year.


### Floral Hardgoods

Everything you need to bring your designs to life, all in one place. From containers, ribbon, foam,
wire, and tools to seasonal décor and everyday essentials, our comprehensive selection of floral
hardgoods makes it easy to shop for everything your business needs with a single order.


### Botanicals

Bring lasting beauty to your customers with a vibrant selection of foliage and blooming plants. With
fresh shipments arriving throughout the week, our botanicals are carefully selected for quality,
freshness, and performance, giving you dependable availability for everyday sales, gifts, decor, and
special events.

# We Aspire To Be Our Customers’
# Most Valuable Supplier

### Your Trusted Wholesale Floral Partner

For more than 65 years, DVFlora has supplied professional retail florists and event designers with
premium fresh-cut flowers, botanicals and floral hardgoods sourced from leading growers and
suppliers around the world. Our strategically located distribution network, including our
headquarters in Sewell, New Jersey, our Southeast hub in Augusta, Georgia, [Marvin’s Wholesale
Florist][37] serving the Indianapolis market, and [Rokay Flowers][38] serving Michigan, provides
dependable next-day service, exceptional product availability, and the flexibility to order by the
bunch, piece, or case. Backed by knowledgeable floral professionals and a commitment to your
success, we’re here to help your business succeed.

## Our Floral & Hardgood Products


### Flowers

From everyday staples to premium specialty blooms, DVFlora offers one of the industry’s largest
selections of fresh-cut flowers sourced from leading growers around the world. Our commitment to
cold-chain management and expert product handling helps ensure every stem arrives with the
freshness, quality, and vase life your customers expect.


### Greens

Complete every arrangement with an extensive selection of fresh-cut greens, foliage, and seasonal
evergreens. Sourced from trusted growers across the globe, our inventory includes everyday
essentials, specialty varieties, and over 100 holiday evergreen selections to help you create
beautiful designs throughout the year.


### Floral Hardgoods

Everything you need to bring your designs to life, all in one place. From containers, ribbon, foam,
wire, and tools to seasonal décor and everyday essentials, our comprehensive selection of floral
hardgoods makes it easy to shop for everything your business needs with a single order.


### Botanicals

Bring lasting beauty to your customers with a vibrant selection of foliage and blooming plants. With
fresh shipments arriving throughout the week, our botanicals are carefully selected for quality,
freshness, and performance, giving you dependable availability for everyday sales, gifts, decor, and
special events.

## **DVFlora Programs**

 *Exclusive to DVFlora customers!*

#### DV Grower Direct

Our DV Grower Direct program is the industry leader in true “Farm-Direct” sourcing.  We put you in
the driver’s seat, with access to over 45 well-known, quality growers and importers from 11
different growing regions around the world – all in one easy to use website – dvflora.com

#### DVFlora Dutch Direct

Enjoy the widest availability of flowers in the world — custom packed to *your* specifications — by
ordering directly from the Aalsmeer flower auctions in Holland! DVFlora Dutch Direct offers a unique
ordering image gallery and easy ordering via dvflora.com or our DVFlora Dutch Direct site. Order on
the go with our DVFlora Dutch mobile app!

#### Cream of the Crop

Your favorite farms and brands are guaranteed each week through our annual and seasonal farm direct
programs: *Cream of the Crop*! Custom pack your favorite flowers and varieties, and take advantage
of guaranteed availability during low production cycles.

#### Distinctive Values

Each week, our dedicated staff of Product Managers are busy sourcing the world for some of the best
specials to offer in our Distinctive Values flyer.  Inside you will find a full list of items, from
Fresh Cut Flowers to Botanicals to Supplies, available for shipping to your store the following week
at great prices.  For more information on how you can receive a copy, please contact your DVFlora
Sales Associate.

# Welcome to eGRO

e-GRO (Electronic Grower Resources Online) is a collaborative effort of floriculture specialists to
create a new clearing house for alerts about disease, insect, environmental, physiological and
nutritional disorders being observed in commercial greenhouses. Information is available about
disorders, podcasts, and research.

Bringing together some of the leading specialists from universities around the USA, e-GRO is a free
resource and learning tool for anybody involved in greenhouse plant production.

The American Society for Horticultural Science awarded e-GRO their "Top Extension Website" for 2013.

[American Floral Endowment] [Fred C. Gloeckner Foundation]

[ Inquire Today ][17]

## Wedding & Event FLORAL

We take great pride in crafting floral designs that are not only creative but deeply thoughtful,
reflecting your unique story and personality. With over 300 weddings completed — ranging from
intimate gatherings to grand celebrations — we are honored to have consistently earned 5-star

## The Farm Nine Difference

Farm Nine has completed well over 300 weddings and we recognize it is one of the most important
stories in a couple’s life. We feel incredibly honored and grateful to be a part of this moment in
your life and your wedding day is a reflection of who you are and what you love.

We take extreme care in designing your flowers with creativity, love, and a lot of thought as to who
you are and what your story is.

[ See Our Floral Services ][25]

### Micaela M.

###### Winter Garden Wedding Testimonial

“We are SO elated that we hired Farm Nine to be our florist for our wedding. Everything was
absolutely spectacular and they executed our vision flawlessly from the centerpieces to the
bouquets. They even went out of their way to find blue spruce trees not native to Florida that were
gorgeous! We couldn’t recommend Farm Nine more.”

Google Testimonial

## The Farm Nine Story

My dream became a reality when my husband, Flor, and I purchased 13 acres and built our farmhouse in
2017. Flor and I, along with our 7 kids, moved in and settled into farm life. We have turkeys,
goats, chickens, donkeys, pigs and milking cows!

But where my childhood dreams really came true was in the rows of blossoming, unique plants that
produce the most beautiful blooms full of fragrance and texture. I am in my element when I am in the
potting shed, designing and arranging breathtaking arrangements of flowers that I picked just one
hundred feet away. It was here that Farm Nine was founded.

## The Farm Nine Story

My dream became a reality when my husband, Flor, and I purchased 13 acres and built our farmhouse in
2017. Flor and I, along with our 7 kids, moved in and settled into farm life. We have turkeys,
goats, chickens, donkeys, pigs and milking cows!

But where my childhood dreams really came true was in the rows of blossoming, unique plants that
produce the most beautiful blooms full of fragrance and texture. I am in my element when I am in the
potting shed, designing and arranging breathtaking arrangements of flowers that I picked just one
hundred feet away. It was here that Farm Nine was founded.

## Chi siamo

Siamo più di un’azienda: **siamo 230 soci e 140 collaboratori** uniti dallo stesso obiettivo —
coltivare valore, **insieme**.

Ci occupiamo di **produzione e commercializzazione di fiori, fogliame reciso e piante in vaso**,
dalla talea al prodotto finito.

Organizziamo la produzione, la trasformazione e la distribuzione di fiori recisi, fogliame e piante
in vaso.

Accanto a questo, offriamo **prodotti e mezzi tecnici per l’agricoltura**, accompagnando chi lavora
la terra con consulenza e supporto tecnico.

Ответы на самые
популярные вопросы
Где проходит мероприятие?
Фестиваль проходит в Отраслевом центре "Цветоводство" (Москва, ул. Шарикоподшипниковская 13, стр 3).
Ближайшее метро - Волгоградский проспект.
Какое ближайшее метро?
Удобнее всего к нам дойти от м. Волгоградский проспект. Рядом также находится м. Дубровка, от него
идти чуть дольше.
Пропускной режим
Отраслевой центр "Цветоводство" находится на территории бывшего шарико-подшипниковского завода,
который сегодня, как и многие бывшие промышленные площадки в стране наполняется новыми и интересными
проектами. Наши соседи - Main stage, VK music, Территория мяча, MIKS Karting, Сквош, DEX и др. У нас
действует пропускной режим, и на КПП могут спросить qr-code для прохода на территорию. Он закреплен
чуть выше.
Нужно ли покупать билет?
Ярмарки — бесплатные и открыты для всех. Однако деловые программы, мастер-классы и посещение
выставки садовых роз могут требовать отдельной регистрации или входного билета.
Можно ли прийти с детьми?
Конечно! На фестивале предусмотрены семейные и детские мастер-классы. Все площадки безопасны
и оборудованы для комфортного пребывания родителей с детьми. Есть кофейня, где можно покормить
детей.
Будет ли еда и напитки?
На территории работает кафе с разнообразным меню. А за нашим вкусным кофе люди приходят в
"Цветоводство" намеренно. Очень рекомендуем его попробовать. Мы стараемся, чтобы каждый гость мог
найти то, что ему по вкусу

Ответы на самые
популярные вопросы
Где проходит мероприятие?
Фестиваль проходит в Отраслевом центре "Цветоводство" (Москва, ул. Шарикоподшипниковская 13, стр 3).
Ближайшее метро - Волгоградский проспект.
Какое ближайшее метро?
Удобнее всего к нам дойти от м. Волгоградский проспект. Рядом также находится м. Дубровка, от него
идти чуть дольше.
Пропускной режим
Отраслевой центр "Цветоводство" находится на территории бывшего шарико-подшипниковского завода,
который сегодня, как и многие бывшие промышленные площадки в стране наполняется новыми и интересными
проектами. Наши соседи - Main stage, VK music, Территория мяча, MIKS Karting, Сквош, DEX и др. У нас
действует пропускной режим, и на КПП могут спросить qr-code для прохода на территорию. Он закреплен
чуть выше.
Нужно ли покупать билет?
Ярмарки — бесплатные и открыты для всех. Однако деловые программы, мастер-классы и посещение
выставки садовых роз могут требовать отдельной регистрации или входного билета.
Можно ли прийти с детьми?
Конечно! На фестивале предусмотрены семейные и детские мастер-классы. Все площадки безопасны
и оборудованы для комфортного пребывания родителей с детьми. Есть кофейня, где можно покормить
детей.
Будет ли еда и напитки?
На территории работает кафе с разнообразным меню. А за нашим вкусным кофе люди приходят в
"Цветоводство" намеренно. Очень рекомендуем его попробовать. Мы стараемся, чтобы каждый гость мог
найти то, что ему по вкусу

# Grown with love

This small business began as an expression of Mckenzie’s lifelong love of flowers. Growing up in a
home filled with color, fragrance, and seasonal beauty, she came to understand early on how much joy
a hand selected bloom can bring. Today, that love has grown into a near-obsession—with dahlias in
particular. From planting to pruning, to the quiet ritual of harvesting, she finds joy in every part
of the process.

Based in our garden in Sammamish, this endeavor is our way of sharing what we love with others.
Mckenzie is well known for sending friends home with a fresh bundle of flowers, and this business
simply extends that spirit outward. Our hope is that these dahlias offer you the chance to pass
along that same joy, one bouquet at a time.

## Purr-fect Creative Partners

Mew.Design is your AI design studio powered by 'Meow Designers'—a team of specialist cats who
transform ideas into visuals. These coded feline agents represent our advanced AI design technology,
each with unique creative superpowers. Brief them just like human designers!

Design Freedom for All — Perfected by Adaptive AI
For Everyday Creators
No design skills? No problem! Generate designs in plain English - like 'Create a neighborhood bake
sale poster with cute cupcake drawings' - or browse community creations for inspiration, then
customize with commands like 'make the font playful' or 'use pastel colors'. Done in seconds.
For Professionals
Multiply your creative output with custom AI Design Agents (meet your new ‘Meow Assistants’!). Train
AI agents in your specialty—whether it’s minimalist posters or kawaii banners—to automate repetitive
tasks. Your curated ‘Meow Agents’ learn from your style and execute briefs at scale.
For Brand Teams
Consistency at scale with branded Meow Agents. Deploy company-tailored AI designers that adhere to
your color palettes, fonts, and visual guidelines. Generate on-brand social posts, ads, and
presentations in seconds—like having an in-house designer for every team member. Need a tailored
design agent? Contact us at **admin@mew.design**

natural language interface lets you create instantly. No layers, no panels—just describe your vision
and get production-ready graphics in seconds.

Go beyond Canva's templates. While template tools limits you to preset layouts, our AI engine
generates truly unique designs—whether you need a social media post, event poster, or business card.
Start fresh or remix community ideas with commands like ‘make it cyberpunk’.

Mew.Design combines AI-generated visuals with intelligent typography—delivering polished posters,
invitations, and flyers with fully editable layouts. Change fonts, adjust spacing, or refine
hierarchies with simple text prompts.

## MINNESOTA FFA

###### Agricultural Education

School-Based Agricultural Education prepares students for successful careers and a lifetime of
informed choices in the global agriculture, food, fiber and natural resources systems.

[ext.jpeg]

###### National FFA Organization

FFA is a national, intra-curricular student organization for those interested in agriculture and
leadership. Per Public Law 116-7,
FFA is one of three components of School-Based A[gricultural Education][40].

[FFA-Day-1000x430.jpg]

###### FFA for All

From the agriculture classroom to the blue jacket, we are dedicated to providing access to and the
experience of premier leadership, personal growth, and career success to all Minnesota youth.

About Us

## Growing Leaders, Building Communities, and Strengthening Agriculture

The FFA experience is valuable to all students, regardless if they do or do not ultimately pursue
agricultural careers. FFA members are both prepared to embark on a career in agriculture through
opportunities available in eight different career pathways, and they are prepared for career success
in another chosen field because the components of the mission become differentiating power skills.
FFA members, regardless of future occupation, become informed and supportive consumers, leaders in
building their communities and help strengthen agriculture.

## MINNESOTA FFA

###### Agricultural Education

School-Based Agricultural Education prepares students for successful careers and a lifetime of
informed choices in the global agriculture, food, fiber and natural resources systems.

[ext.jpeg]

###### National FFA Organization

FFA is a national, intra-curricular student organization for those interested in agriculture and
leadership. Per Public Law 116-7,
FFA is one of three components of School-Based A[gricultural Education][40].

[FFA-Day-1000x430.jpg]

###### FFA for All

From the agriculture classroom to the blue jacket, we are dedicated to providing access to and the
experience of premier leadership, personal growth, and career success to all Minnesota youth.

About Us

## Growing Leaders, Building Communities, and Strengthening Agriculture

The FFA experience is valuable to all students, regardless if they do or do not ultimately pursue
agricultural careers. FFA members are both prepared to embark on a career in agriculture through
opportunities available in eight different career pathways, and they are prepared for career success
in another chosen field because the components of the mission become differentiating power skills.
FFA members, regardless of future occupation, become informed and supportive consumers, leaders in
building their communities and help strengthen agriculture.

## Floral Design

We believe the little things make all the difference between something nice and something
unforgettable. We hold true to our passion of making even the smallest details special and unique.

Floral services range from full service floral and decor design to DIY and a la carte packages.

[Travis and Deb groomsmen.jpg]
[Myriah and John The Wedding-Jiminez Wedding-0953.jpg]
[KateandGregWedding-185.jpg]
[Styled Elopement -082_websize.jpg]


### full service FLORAL - curated DESIGN plan // Starting at $10,000

This service includes decor design planning or collaboration with your wedding planner. From linens
to tableware, vessels, signs and decor, we aim to create one cohesive and signature look that blends
flowers with your design style and color palette.

### FULL SERVICE FLORAL - standard packages // STARTING AT $4500

This service is designed for the client whose florals are inspired by contemporary styles and
current trends. The PacWest Blooms floral team has created price point packages based on guest
counts and covering the standard areas (Personal, Ceremony and Reception) that need flowers. This
package does not include custom or luxe flowers.

For the 2023 Season minimums start at

100+ guests $6,000

50 - 99 guests $4,500

### A LA CARTE // DIY // elopement florals

We have you covered in the areas of personal, ceremony and reception flowers. Your choice of designs
that do not require setup or teardown (such as bride and bridesmaid bouquets, boutonnieres and
corsages, centerpieces, and accent bouquets). For designs that require on-site installation, such as
arch flowers, chandelier and ceiling flowers, floral backdrops, and elevated centerpieces, clients
may choose Full Service Floral Design.

———————-

### pacifica package // Starting at $5200

This package is created for an intimate celebration of 20 guests or less. Beach or courthouse
weddings with dinner at a local restaurant, hotel or private residence are what this package is
curated for and includes event coordination, the couples personal flowers, garden chairs for the
ceremony, reception flowers and 6” ceremonial cake. Please inquire for high level details.

## Encouraging biodiversity into our built environment

We are an innovation led company that combine planting and technology to bring biodiversity back
into our cities and clean the air.

We use sustainable planting in strategic locations to form biodiversity corridors through our
cities.

Wayfinding and placemaking for our insects and birds, air cleaning for our city dwellers.

As horticulturalists we are proud of our achievements in being globally responsible and helping
fight climate change.

With your help we can make a difference by collaborating, inspiring, and sharing our knowledge and
passion as we breathe life back into cities.

# Breathing Life Into Cities

[ Book Your CPD ][59]
[ Our Products & Services ][60]
[our vision]

## Encouraging biodiversity into our built environment

We are an innovation led company that combine planting and technology to bring biodiversity back
into our cities and clean the air.

We use sustainable planting in strategic locations to form biodiversity corridors through our
cities.

Wayfinding and placemaking for our insects and birds, air cleaning for our city dwellers.

As horticulturalists we are proud of our achievements in being globally responsible and helping
fight climate change.

With your help we can make a difference by collaborating, inspiring, and sharing our knowledge and
passion as we breathe life back into cities.

[ Read More ][61]
